pr.title: Fix overseer stall detection false positives in implement phase
pr.description:
Add phase-aware heartbeat/progress thresholds and BRC-idle suppression
to the Tier 1 health monitor. The implement phase uses a 600s timeout
(vs 120s default) and agents correctly idle in BRC protocol are excluded
from stall alerts entirely.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: New tests in test_health_monitor.py for phase-aware thresholds and BRC suppression
- Manual: Run a pipeline with implement phase and verify no false-positive alerts for idle BRC agents
